description: Add-on, not a routing preset: adds the browser adapter's MCP server (DESIGN §43; docs/seraphina/BROWSER_AND_CODEX.md §2): the installed bin/sf-browser, which builds its own namespace (sandbox self), required (a browsing turn whose browser cannot start fails with the reason), with the shim's nine tools only and a 60-second MCP timeout above the shim's own 20. Changes no routing and leaves browsing off: set browser.runtime.dir to the harness's own runtime (Node, Playwright MCP 0.0.83 and the Chrome build) and turn browser.enabled on, then give a browsing persona (tools: none, mcp: browser, browser: fixture) a dedicated Open WebUI preset that carries no writer and no transmitter.
